Common questions

Can’t find your answer? WhatsApp us, we reply fast.

How is storage priced?

Every 4 weeks, by unit size. No setup or admin fees. VAT at the standard UAE rate.

What’s the minimum period?

1-week minimum stay, billed every 4 weeks. Cancel any time with 14 days’ notice.

Can I store furniture during a renovation?

Yes. Rent for as short as one week and extend as needed.

Can I store a sofa, bed and wardrobe?

Yes. 50 to 75 sq ft usually fits a 1 to 2 bedroom apartment. Try the size estimator to check.

Can you pick up from my home?

Yes. Send your address and item list on WhatsApp for a quote.
